logline: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.
continuity: Picks up immediately after Episode 8, continuing the peaceful evening inside the cottage before an urgent knock shatters the calm.

events.text: Medium close-up of Juliana at the wooden table by candlelight, grinding dried herbs with a pestle inside a stone mortar.
Juliana methodically crushes herbs in the mortar beside her open herbal grimoire.
Heavy, frantic pounding echoes against the heavy wooden cottage door.
Juliana stops grinding and lifts her head sharply toward the entrance in alarm.
Close-up of Alexander turning toward the doorway, his eyes sharp and vigilant.

events.speaker: Alexander
events.text: Stay back. I'll open it.
Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.
Medium shot framing the doorway as a soaked, distraught peasant mother steps across the threshold clutching a swaddled child.

events.speaker: Peasant Mother
events.text: Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!
Medium shot of Juliana rushing to the front of the table, extending her arms urgently.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: Bring him here. Quickly.
The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.
Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.
Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?
Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.
Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.

events.speaker: Peasant Mother
events.text: Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset.
Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.
Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: Feverfew... Not alone.
Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: Chamomile... and willow bark.
Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.

events.speaker: Alexander
events.text: You're certain?
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: I have to be.
Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: Alexander, I need hot water.

events.speaker: Alexander
events.text: I'm on it.
Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.

events.speaker: Peasant Mother
events.text: Please save him.
Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: He is not beyond saving.
Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.
The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.
Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.

events.speaker: Peasant Mother
events.text: Why isn't it working?
Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: Wait.
Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.
Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.

events.speaker: Peasant Mother
events.text: His fever... it's breaking.
Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.
Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.

events.speaker: Peasant Mother
events.text: You saved him.
Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: The herbs did their work. Let him rest.
Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.

events.speaker: Peasant Mother
events.text: I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you.
The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.

events.speaker: Alexander
events.text: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.
Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: A child's life matters more than gossip.
Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.

events.speaker: Alexander
events.text: Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous.
Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.

events.speaker: Juliana
events.text: Then we will face it together.
Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.
The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.

events.speaker: Blond Nobleman
events.text: What is it?
Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.

events.speaker: The Former Groom
events.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

events.speaker: Blond Nobleman
events.text: What rumor?
Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.

events.speaker: The Former Groom
events.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.
Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.

events.speaker: Blond Nobleman
events.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.
Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.

events.speaker: The Former Groom
events.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.

events.speaker: Blond Nobleman
events.text: Where?
Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.

events.speaker: The Former Groom
events.text: No one seems certain.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.

events.speaker: Blond Nobleman
events.text: Then let it remain a rumor.
Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.
Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.

events.speaker: Blond Nobleman
events.text: Impossible.
Extreme close-up macro shot of the Blond Nobleman's eye, the flickering fireplace flames dancing across his widening iris as dark dread paralyzes him, holding until the screen cuts to black.
